Chapter 805: Chapter 17: Astonishing Harvest (Eight Thousand Words, Two Chapters Combined)_5

“`

However.

The next moment.

Under the incredulous gazes of all Demonic Divine Masters.

Lin Yuan’s figure suddenly began to surge, transforming into a colossal giant reaching thousands of miles high, lifting his right hand and grasping directly towards the depths of the nest.

Boom, rumble.

...

Terrifying aura vibrated continuously, this nest, as the lair of Void Creatures, was bound to be fraught with peril, but under Lin Yuan’s grasp, time and space whirled, everything was being annihilated.

“This…” The Heavenly Python Divine Master, who was originally waiting for Lin Yuan to recover, fell silent, its heart trembling slightly as it beheld Lin Yuan’s towering form, as though he were heaven and earth.

Although among the Demonic Divine Masters, combat power does not directly correlate with size, the boundless aura emanating from Lin Yuan’s million-mile figure was making the Heavenly Python Divine Master’s scalp tingle.

Moreover, with Lin Yuan’s grasp, the vast nest began to collapse from its foundation, further showcasing Lin Yuan’s terrifying strength.

The other Demonic Divine Masters witnessed this scene, their mouths agape in awe, they had to painstakingly plan to gather twenty Divine Masters to be confident of invading the Void Creature Nest, but Lin Yuan pierced through it with one hand?

Boom, rumble.

The Void Creature Nest continued to collapse unceasingly, Lin Yuan’s arm that reached in kept going deeper until at a certain moment, it finally stopped.

And at this time, it was as if the entire nest erupted in ‘fury’, horrific power surged into Lin Yuan’s arm that reached in, but with a flash of Xuan Huang light, everything was pacified and annihilated.

Silence.

Nineteen Demonic Divine Masters watched this scene in shock, the trembling of the Void Creature Nest just now was obviously a strike that gathered all its strength, but, evidently, it was easily blocked by the Taiyang Divine Master.

Blocked with incredible ease.

Just what kind of power does this Taiyang Divine Master possess?

“This Taiyang Divine Master, who rose to power in just three to five hundred years, how can his strength be so formidable?”

“Too terrifying.”

The Demonic Divine Masters trembled in their hearts.

Whirr.

The next moment.

Under the watchful eyes of all the Demonic Divine Masters.

Lin Yuan’s arm that stretched deep into the nest retracted, and soon completely withdrew from the nest.

And at this time, the Demonic Divine Masters only noticed that Lin Yuan’s right hand was already grasping two Void Creatures.

These two Void Creatures were struggling desperately, the aura they emitted was not the least bit inferior to the many Demonic Divine Masters present, but Lin Yuan’s fingers were like a cage of time and space, sealing both Void Creatures completely within.

Then, with a gentle squeeze of Lin Yuan’s right hand.

Both Void Creatures were annihilated, their forms ethereal, an invisible force entered Lin Yuan’s body, enhancing his Spirit Will.

Next.

Lin Yuan’s right hand delved into the nest again.

When it withdrew again, between his fingers were three more Void Creatures.

Then crushed.

In the blink of an eye, six Void Creatures had died by Lin Yuan’s hand.

Lin Yuan’s right hand stretched into the nest again, and when it retracted, it similarly held three Void Creatures.

Powerful enough to make the Demonic Divine Masters wary, the Void Creatures were like little chicks between Lin Yuan’s fingers, crushed whenever he wished.

“Is that a Void Creature Monarch?”

The Heavenly Python Divine Master immediately noticed that among the Void Creatures Lin Yuan brought back the third time, one of them had a faint golden hue.

The Void Creature Monarch is the king of all Void Creatures, possessing the ability to command other Void Creatures.

Similarly, the king of Void Creatures, once killed, the boost to Spirit Will is terrifyingly significant, equivalent to dozens of the same rank Void Creatures.

Discovering the Void Creature Monarch in Lin Yuan’s palm, the eyes of other Demonic Divine Masters turned a bit red, but thinking about the strength Lin Yuan displayed, none of them dared to step forward, their gazes continuously turning towards the Heavenly Python Divine Master.

“Taiyang Divine Master.”

Seeing this, the Heavenly Python Divine Master mustered his courage and immediately spoke: “This nest was first discovered by us…”

Whoooosh!!!

The words of Heavenly Python Divine Master propagated through space and time, vast and mighty.

At this moment, Lin Yuan was examining the Void Creature Monarch in his palm,

This was his first encounter with a king of Void Creatures, and it was a Ninth Stage Void Creature King.

Hearing the Heavenly Python Divine Master’s inquiry, Lin Yuan shifted his gaze, glancing at the Heavenly Python Divine Master.

Hum.

The Heavenly Python Divine Master immediately felt his scalp explode, Lin Yuan’s gaze seemed to set him on fire, a terrifying Spirit Will, like a blazing fire that consumed everything, continuously assaulted him.

Immediately, the Heavenly Python Divine Master continued: “But since you, Taiyang Divine Master have come, this nest is yours, we will retreat, we will back off right away…”

Before he could finish speaking, the Heavenly Python Divine Master fled like a beaten dog to the distance.

The remaining eighteen Demonic Divine Masters, likewise, quickly distanced themselves from Lin Yuan.

These nineteen Demonic Divine Masters, daring to gather together, was because their strengths were not too disparate, none having the capability to kill any Divine Master.

But Lin Yuan?

With Lin Yuan’s ability to extract three or four Ninth Stage Void Creatures with one hand, the present Demonic Divine Masters did not doubt that he had the means to kill an ordinary Demonic Divine Master.

Originally, the many Divine Masters had hoped that the Heavenly Python Divine Master would represent them, nearly twenty Master Demons, and perhaps make the Taiyang Divine Master warier.

At least to share a few ordinary Void Creatures.

The Taiyang Divine Master eats meat, they also wanted to sip the broth.

But witnessing Taiyang Divine Master’s performance, where would these Divine Masters dare to linger?

If they don’t run now, do they wait for Taiyang Divine Master to completely deal with the Void Creature Monarch, then free up his hands to deal with them?
